anti_overlap: fd-epistemics-axiom-advocacy-adjudication covers whether the axiom/validity epistemic split is honest framing — this agent covers only whether the numeric gates that sit inside the 'validity-scoped' half are themselves measurable and non-gameable, taking no position on whether the axiom declaration is legitimate.

fd-systems-narrative-inevitable-doom-agency covers whether the resulting gameplay and canon experience of these gates lands as meaningful agency or cheapened distinctiveness — this agent covers only the statistical/measurement validity of the gates themselves, not their downstream experiential consequences.
decision_lens: Prioritizes findings where a numerically-precise-sounding gate (90–98%, ≤70%, IQR ≥ 20 years, |d| ≥ 0.3) cannot actually be estimated, distinguished from adjacent values, or defended against gaming at the stated seed budget or with the stated instrumentation — especially where the failure is silent (the gate reports pass/fail cleanly but the underlying quantity it's supposed to measure is not what's actually being captured, e.g., max_by attribution collapsing multiplex into an artifact of measurement order rather than true causal contribution). Deprioritizes findings about whether the target values are the 'right' values in a design-taste sense (that's the gameplay/epistemics lenses' territory) and focuses only on whether the values as stated are measurable, stable, and resistant to gaming with the tools shadow-work actually has.
focus: Whether the 90–98% neutral-policy incidence target is a calibratable, falsifiable knife-edge given a ~256-seed sweep budget, or whether it is a number that cannot be distinguished from 100% (silent ratchet) or from a much lower drifted value (e.g., 60%) in practice — and whether the ≤70% multiplex single-source gate is well-defined and non-gameable given known attribution-instrument issues (max_by pre-collapse attribution collapse, f-029), including whether the modulation dynamic-range gates (T₀ shift ≥ N years, severity AUC at |d| ≥ 0.3, IQR ≥ 20 years, agent-ablation hard stop) are jointly identifiable rather than confounded
name: fd-calibration-statistics-knife-edge-validity
persona: Apply the perspective of an applied statistician / simulation-calibration methodologist who specializes in stochastic-system sensitivity analysis and small-sample inference — someone who has calibrated agent-based or Monte Carlo models against sparse seed budgets, knows the difference between a target that is nominally precise (90–98%) and a target that is estimable at the stated sample size with usable confidence intervals, is fluent in the failure modes of threshold/gate-based validation (gates that are satisfiable by construction, gates confounded by a shared upstream driver, attribution measures that break under near-simultaneous or compounding causes), and treats 'this metric sounds well-defined' as a hypothesis to be checked against the actual instrumentation rather than accepted from the ruling's prose.
review_areas: Statistical power and identifiability: with ~256 seeds, can the sweep actually distinguish a 90–98% incidence target from 100%-by-construction (the ratchet the ruling explicitly wants to avoid) or from a drifted lower value like 60%, given expected variance in a stochastic multi-agent simulation — what confidence interval does 256 seeds actually buy on a binary collapse/no-collapse outcome, and is it narrow enough to police an 8-point band (90 vs 98)

The ≤70% multiplex single-source gate's dependence on the attribution instrument: given the known max_by pre-collapse attribution issue (f-029, where attribution collapses to whichever pressure was measured last/largest rather than true proportional causal contribution), does the 70% threshold measure genuine multiplex causation or an artifact of how PressureAttribution is computed and cleared per-tick — is there a concrete seed/scenario where a single dominant driver would read as <70% purely due to measurement-order artifacts, or vice versa

Joint identifiability of the modulation dynamic-range gates: T₀ dispersion (IQR ≥ 20 years), strong-vs-null T₀ shift (≥ N years), and severity AUC (|d| ≥ 0.3) are being validated as if independent, but do they share an upstream driver (e.g., the same policy-strength parameter moves all three simultaneously) such that passing one gate mechanically passes or fails the others, making the 'four independent gates' framing overstated

The agent-ablation hard stop's statistical power: 'all modulation must vanish under agent-effects ablation' is a strong claim requiring the ablated condition to show no significant residual effect — is 'vanish' operationalized with a specific null-hypothesis test and seed count sufficient to detect direct-control leakage at a defensible power, or can a leaky bench pass this gate simply because the ablation study is underpowered to detect the leak

Gameability under optimization pressure: if calibration is tuned iteratively against these gates (a common practice), do the gates admit a parameter region that satisfies all four numeric thresholds while being 'dramatically/causally inert' in the sense the prior run's f-005/f-009 (policy-reachability theatre) already flagged — i.e., do these specific numeric gates close that theatre risk or just relocate it behind harder-to-audit statistics

Whether the near-miss tail (the thin, hard-to-reach non-collapse outcomes implied by not-100%) is itself calibratable and observable at 256 seeds, or whether it is a theoretically-declared feature of the model that the sweep budget can never actually produce or verify, making the 'not 100%-by-construction, for falsifiability' framing untestable in practice even though it's presented as an empirical safeguard

severity_examples.condition: The binomial confidence interval on a 256-seed sample at the true underlying rate is wide enough (e.g., a true rate of 85% or 100% both produce observed samples plausibly read as '90–98%') that the reported number cannot actually discriminate the intended calibration target from either a silent 100%-by-construction ratchet or a meaningfully looser rate — the falsifiability the ruling claims to preserve by avoiding a hard 100% floor is statistically theatrical, because no feasible seed budget can tell the difference, and this won't surface until someone tries to replicate the calibration and gets a different number
severity_examples.scenario: The calibration sweep runs ~256 seeds under neutral policy and reports the incidence landed in the 90–98% band

severity_examples.condition: The ≤70% multiplex gate reads this as compliant multiplex causation (no single source over 70%) purely because of max_by's known pre-collapse attribution-collapse behavior (f-029), when the actual causal structure is a soloist — the gate is gameable (or falsely-failed) in exactly the direction that matters most, and because the gate reports a clean number, no one downstream will know the multiplex requirement was never really tested
severity_examples.scenario: A seed run shows one pressure family (e.g., economic_strain) as the overwhelming true causal driver of the collapse window, but two other pressures happen to be measured as marginally larger at the specific tick max_by samples

severity_examples.condition: All four move together because they share the same upstream policy-strength scalar in the current architecture, so passing the T₀-shift gate under a given policy tuning mechanically produces passing severity AUC and IQR as a side effect rather than as independent evidence — the ruling's four-gate framing overstates the number of independent checks actually being performed, giving false confidence that modulation has been validated on multiple axes when it's been validated on one
severity_examples.scenario: The four modulation gates (T₀ shift, severity AUC, IQR, agent-ablation) are validated as separate pass/fail checks in the calibration protocol

success_hints: The review computes or reasonably estimates whether ~256 seeds provides sufficient statistical power to distinguish the 90–98% incidence band from both 100%-by-construction and a meaningfully drifted lower rate, rather than asserting power qualitatively.

The review traces the ≤70% multiplex gate against the specific known attribution-instrument defect (max_by pre-collapse, f-029) with a concrete scenario showing where the gate would misfire in either direction.

The review checks whether the four modulation dynamic-range gates (T₀ shift, severity AUC, IQR, agent-ablation) are actually statistically independent or share a confounding upstream driver, naming the driver if one exists.

The review addresses whether the near-miss tail (implied by not-100%) is observable/calibratable at the stated seed budget at all, distinguishing 'theoretically declared to exist' from 'empirically measurable'.
The review connects any gate-gaming finding back to the prior run's policy-reachability-theatre findings (f-005/f-009) rather than treating gameability as a new, unrelated risk.
task_context: Design inquiry, calibration-methodology round: probing whether the proposed Jackpot ruling's numeric gates are actually estimable, stable, and non-gameable given shadow-work's real seed budget and known attribution-instrument defects, following the prior run's finding that policy-reachability gates can pass while causally inert (f-005/f-009) and that pressure attribution collapses under max_by pre-collapse measurement (f-029). Overall generative goal for this review round: maximize verified novelty×risk surface until dry — answering: is 'inevitable but modulatable' (the Gibson Jackpot ruling: ~90-98% neutral incidence, multiplex ≤70% single-source gate, modulation dynamic-range gates replacing occurrence gates, agent-ablation hard stop, inevitability + 2065-2145 window as declared universe axioms with validity scoped to modulation structure) the right ruling for shadow-work's Jackpot calibration — where does it fail gameplay, bench validity, canon emergence, or epistemic honesty?
